question: What bodily form results from constant practice of this yoga?
premises: The practitioner comes to have that form.
inference: Through constant practice of this yoga, one may attain the form of a sixteen-year-old.
uncertainties: dvi-aṣṭa-varṣa is interpreted as sixteen years.
plain_english: Through constant practice of this yoga, one attains the form of a sixteen-year-old.
